title: Onigiri Shaped Mushroom Koftas
description: A unique twist on traditional koftas, these Indian-inspired bites feature onigiri-shaped mushroom filling wrapped in Japanese-style bread.
instructions: 1. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a bowl, mix together mushrooms, zesty, earthy, japanese, salt, and black pepper.
3. On a flat surface, shape onigiri into small disks.
4. Place a spoonful of the mushroom mixture onto the center of each onigiri.
5. Fold the onigiri in half to enclose the filling, and press gently to seal.
6. Brush the tops of the koftas with oil.
7. Grill the koftas for 3-4 minutes per side, or until crispy and golden brown.
8. Serve hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
